about_short_description.short_description: Stainless is a company that specializes in generating software development kits for APIs.

product.name: SDK Generation
product.description: Generates software development kits (SDKs) from OpenAPI specifications to provide typed client libraries in multiple programming languages.

product.name: MCP Server Generation
product.description: Generates Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers from OpenAPI specs to enable API tool integration with AI clients and web-based interfaces.

product.name: SDK Studio
product.description: A web-based interface for previewing, editing, and managing SDK configurations and OpenAPI specs.

product.name: Terraform Provider Generation
product.description: Generates Terraform providers from OpenAPI specs to enable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) management of API resources.

product.name: OpenAPI Spec Integration and Automation
product.description: Automates SDK updates and releases by integrating OpenAPI spec changes via GitHub Actions and other CI/CD pipelines.
